title: Heightmap terrain from fractal noise
purpose: Generate a square terrain mesh from seeded fractal gradient noise, with central-difference normals, UVs and colours banded by height and slope. Use it for game ground, backdrops and test terrain.

entry_points.name: height_at
entry_points.signature: height_at(x, z, height=6.0, feature_size=14.0, octaves=5, seed=7)
entry_points.summary: Terrain height in metres at horizontal position (x, z): fBm gradient noise times ``height``.

entry_points.name: terrain_color
entry_points.summary: RGBA colour for a height in [0, 1] (low to high) and a steepness in [0, 1] (flat to vertical).

entry_points.name: heightmap_terrain
entry_points.signature: heightmap_terrain(size=40.0, resolution=40, height=6.0, feature_size=14.0, octaves=5, seed=7)
entry_points.summary: A terrain mesh of (resolution + 1)^2 vertices and resolution^2 quads, centred on the origin, +Y up.

entry_points.name: main
entry_points.summary: Command line: write the terrain as .gltf or .obj and print a JSON summary.

parameters.name: size
parameters.meaning: Side length of the square terrain, centred on the origin.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.meaning: Grid cells per side; the grid has (resolution + 1)^2 vertices.

parameters.name: height
parameters.meaning: Noise amplitude; heights stay within about plus or minus this value.

parameters.name: feature_size
parameters.meaning: Horizontal size of the largest hills (the first noise octave's wavelength).

parameters.name: octaves
parameters.meaning: Noise octaves; each adds detail at half the size and half the amplitude.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.meaning: Noise seed; the same seed gives the same terrain.

outputs.content: the terrain mesh with POSITION, NORMAL, TEXCOORD_0 and COLOR_0, indexed triangles
the terrain as Wavefront OBJ with positions, texture coordinates, normals and quads

limits: A single height per (x, z): no overhangs, caves or arches. The noise is not periodic, so tiles do not wrap. Heights stay within about plus or minus the height parameter (at most twice it). The colour bands are a fixed stylized palette, not a physical material model.
